setup: A spherical triangle and its polar triangle are related part by part, and this instance gives one of those parts or all three.

steps.say: The polar triangle is built from the poles of the original sides, and the construction makes each part of one triangle the supplement of a part of the other.
A supplement is 180 degrees minus the given part, so 180 - A, 180 - B and 180 - C are the three sides of the polar triangle.
When all three are asked for together, they add to 540 degrees minus the sum of the three original angles.
